products.title: P.S 4-Piece Interlocking Printer Base Tray
products.description: Four-piece modular base tray concept for the Flashforge AD5X. CAD geometry, stability, ventilation and fit are awaiting verification. Not available to order.

products.title: Cooper Sleeping Pug Figurine (Concept)
products.material: PLA+ black with white chest accent (IFS)
products.description: Lying black pug with the white chest patch, modelled after Cooper. Check render only: the STL has not been printed on the AD5X yet, so there is no finished photograph, price or buy link. Sale status waits for a real test print, photo and safety check.
products.photo_alt: Model check render of the lying black pug figurine concept; a preview, not a photograph of a finished print.

products.title: P.S Tracksuit Balaclava Figure (Concept)
products.material: PLA+ black with white IFS hood, eyes and chest mark
products.description: Standing studio figure in the black tracksuit and proper mask with round base. Check render only; inlay fit still needs a first AD5X test print before this can be listed for sale.
products.photo_alt: Model check render of the black tracksuit balaclava figure concept; a preview, not a photograph of a finished print.

products.title: BruceyBonus Keyring Pack (Concept)
products.material: PLA+ black body with white raised-lettering insert
products.description: Wider BruceyBonus keyring family beyond the live round keyring: bar style, tag style and detailed two-tone badge. Check renders only; the detailed badge and bar/tag shapes are untested on the AD5X and are not for sale.
products.photo_alt: Model check render of the single-colour round BruceyBonus keyring; a preview, not a photograph of a finished print.

products.title: Vehicle Trim and Cosmetic Parts (Validation Only)
products.material: ASA or PETG-CF required for car parts; PLA is a mock-up only
products.description: Parametric bumper, grille and rear-light surround parts for the Transit Connect and Bandit 400. None has been fitted to a vehicle. Car parts need ASA or PETG-CF for heat and UV, blank badge areas only, and a dry-fit before any sale; rear-light surrounds must never cover the lit lens.

how_to_add: See docs/3D-PRINT-SHOP.md. Copy the template, put the photo in images/3d-prints/, set active true only when price_gbp, photo, stock and buy_url are filled in. Files named *-render.png are model check renders, never sale photos, and stay active:false. npm test checks every entry.

template.title: Name of the print
